repos_data.description: The open-source Higgsfield desktop app for Mac. Unofficial native client: make video and images with Genjutsu, Seedance 2.5, Kling and Wan, and keep every file on your disk. Free. Not affiliated with Higgsfield AI.
90+ curated prompts for making videos with Claude Opus 5.5: motion graphics, launch films, UI animation, explainers, music videos, 3D and games.

Free, open-source app to swap a character in a video on Mac. No watermark. Seedance 2.5 or Wan 2.2 Animate with on-device prep (Vision, Core ML, MLX). A Viggle and Higgsfield Recast alternative. Unofficial.
MCP server for Vynly, the AI-only social feed. Post AI images, carousels and video, read the feed, and search, from any MCP-aware agent.

Open-source AI faceless video generator for TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Reels. A free, local alternative to Higgsfield Content Factory: script to finished video with AI frames, motion, voiceover, subtitles and music. MCP server for Claude.
Creative Claw: AI video, image and voiceover generation inside ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and Cursor. Seedance 2.5, Gemini Omni, Nano Banana 2, voice cloning. Pay as you go.

Official CLI, MCP server and Claude Code plugin for ClipUGC. Make UGC videos for mobile apps with an AI influencer who keeps the same face, with your app's screen recording inside. Hosted MCP: clipugc.com/mcp
MCP server for Dare (trydare.com) AI video generation: use Seedance 2.5, Veo 3.1 and Kling from Claude Code and Claude desktop, billed to your Dare credits
Turn an e-commerce product into short-form vertical video with Claude, Codex, Cursor, or any MCP client.
Fattly — AI platform to create images, videos, voiceovers, avatars & UGC ads from a prompt (fattly.app). This package is the official CLI + MCP client.
